title: IVG 2400 Reload Peach Edition Prefilled Vape Pods - 20mg - 4PK
description: Designed for use with the IVG 2400 Reload Prefilled Pod Kit, these IVG 2400 Reload Prefilled Pods provide an easy way to refresh your device with smooth and juicy fruit flavours. Each pack contains four individual 2ml prefilled pods, delivering up to 2400 puffs per kit (depending on personal usage) while ensuring smooth and consistent vapour production. The Peach Edition showcases a selection of peach-inspired blends, combining soft, sweet, and citrus-infused notes for a well-rounded fruit profile: Peach Apple – A naturally sweet and fresh mix of soft Peach and crisp Apple. Peach Pineapple Mango – A tropical fusion of juicy Peach, tangy Pineapple, and ripe Mango. Peach Cherry Soda – A playful blend of sweet Peach and tart Cherry with a fizzy soda finish. Peach Ice – A smooth and juicy Peach flavour, finished with a cooling menthol breeze. Swapping pods is effortless—just replace an empty pod with a fresh one and continue enjoying your vape. Whether you're looking for an easy way to keep your device ready or a simple alternative to disposables, these pods provide a convenient and reliable vaping solution.
